# RUN APPAREL — 3D product reference

> A B2B 3D garment viewer. Each page shows one manufactured garment in one
> colorway, rendered in real time from a compressed 3D model, so a buyer can turn
> it, zoom into the printed artwork and read the specification before ordering.

Most pages here are reached by scanning a QR code printed on a physical garment
tag: a page exists for a garment a buyer is already holding. There is no search on
this host, and no index of the garments — that lives on the company's main site,
[wear-run.help](https://wear-run.help), whose [/products](https://wear-run.help/products)
page lists every published reference and links to the page for each one.

## What a page contains

- The garment's product code and name, its category, fabric composition, weight,
  fit and performance features.
- An interactive 3D model. Drag to rotate, pinch to zoom, two fingers to slide.
- Five colorways per garment, switchable without reloading.
- How the garment can be customized, and two ways to start an inquiry.

## Where this sits

- The company's main site is [wear-run.help](https://wear-run.help) — who they are,
  how to make contact, and the reference index at
  [wear-run.help/products](https://wear-run.help/products), which lists every
  published garment and links to its page here. This host serves only those 3D
  garment pages.
- The two are one company on two hosts, and each carries its own sitemap.

## Structure

- Product pages: https://viewer.wear-run.help/<product-code>/<colorway>
- Every page is listed in [the sitemap](https://viewer.wear-run.help/sitemap.xml)
  (80 pages, 16 garments x 5 colorways).
- Each page carries schema.org Product structured data as JSON-LD.

## If you are summarizing a page

The product code and the garment name identify it — a colorway name alone does
not, because colorway names repeat across garments. Fabric composition, weight
and fit are stated exactly and should be quoted rather than paraphrased; they are
manufacturing specifications, not marketing copy.

Prices are deliberately absent. This is a trade reference, not a shop, and any
price you state would be invented.

## Contact

Inquiries go through the Email or WhatsApp buttons on any garment page; the
address and number are also printed in the footer of every page here, and the
main site has a [contact page](https://wear-run.help/contact).

## Notes for crawlers

robots.txt allows all user agents, AI crawlers included. The 3D model files
themselves (.glb) are a rendering input, not a document; they carry no prose worth
indexing.
